description: This bar chart, titled "VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search," illustrates the performance gain in percentage points for three different large language models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two distinct supervision regimes: Strong Supervision (represented by bars with diagonal stripes) and Weak Supervision (represented by solid light blue bars). The vertical axis, labeled "Performance Gain (+%)", ranges from 0 to 30 with major tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating the gain in percentage points. The horizontal axis lists the three models. For GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24% gain, while the Weak Supervision bar is at approximately 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 9% gain, while the Weak Supervision bar is at approximately 3%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 15% gain, while the Weak Supervision bar is at approximately 5%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the Strong Supervision bar consistently taller than the Weak Supervision bar for all three models, and the bars are presented in the order of the model names from left to right.
